note.after_visit_summary: You have atrial fibrillation, which is under control. Your blood pressure is at goal. You are taking apixaban 5 mg twice a day to prevent stroke, metoprolol 50 mg once a day to control your heart rate, and lisinopril 10 mg daily for blood pressure. Continue fish oil 1000 mg daily. Stop taking aspirin because it increases your risk of bleeding when combined with apixaban and does not help your heart. Use a soft toothbrush and tell your dentist about gum bleeding. Get a blood count check in three months at the lab on 2210 Wexford Avenue. Call us if you have black stools, blood in urine, or a nosebleed that does not stop after 20 minutes. If you fall and hit your head, go to the emergency room right away, even if you feel fine. Return in six months for follow-up.
